title: CWP/1891/2025 of ANIL SAINI Vs STATE OF HARYANA
text:
116 (2nd case) IN THE HIGH COURT OF PUNJAB AND HARYANA AT CHANDIGARH Date of decision: February 25, 2025 Anil Saini ….Petitioner versus State of Haryana and others ….Respondents CORAM: HON’BLE MR. JUSTICE SUDHIR SINGH HON’BLE MRS. JUSTICE SUKHVINDER KAUR Present:- Mr. Sahil Gupta, Advocate for the petitioner. Mr. Samarth Sagar, Additional AG Haryana. SUDHIR SINGH, J. (ORAL) Petition herein is for issuance of a Writ in the nature of Certiorari for quashing the notification dated 01.01.2025 (Annexure P-1) issued by the Commissioner and Secretary to Government of Haryana, Urban Local Bodies Department, whereby Ward No.2 of the Municipal Corporation, Rohtak has been reserved for Scheduled Caste Category.

2. At the outset, learned State counsel submits that as the process of election in respect of the concerned Municipal Corporation is already underway, therefore, the instant writ petition has become infructuous, and no substantive relief can be granted to the petitioner.

3. Faced with the situation, learned counsel for the petitioner does not dispute the aforesaid; he, however, submits that a liberty may be granted 1 of 2 to the petitioner to file a representation before respondent No.6-Deputy Commissioner, Rohtak for redressal of his grievance, and the same be decided at the earliest.

4. Learned State counsel submits that in case, any such representation is moved by the petitioner, respondent No.6 shall take decision either way on the same.

5. Without commenting on merits of the case, the petition is disposed of with a liberty to the petitioner to make a representation before respondent No.6-Deputy Commissioner, Rohtak qua redressal of his grievance. In case, such an application is made by the petitioner, respondent No.6 shall consider the same and pass an appropriate reasoned order, in accordance with law.

6. Pending application(s), if any, shall also stand disposed of. (SUDHIR SINGH) JUDGE (SUKHVINDER KAUR) JUDGE February 25, 2025 mahavir 2 of 2
